content.text: In Nigeria, Stripe is unavailable, but you still need a digital store to sell ebooks, courses, and plugins. This infrastructure [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/problem-financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-how-solve|The Problem]] is not unique to Nigeria; it's a common issue in many countries with restricted [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-minimum-viable-stack-2|payment]] platforms. That's why COREMERCH offers a sovereign digital commerce stack, giving you full ownership and control over your digital store, without relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

COREMERCH's Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provide a complete digital commerce solution, complete with GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually-5|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This infrastructure is designed to work when platforms fail, giving you full ownership and control over your digital store.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you'll need to create a NOWPayments account, which is required for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. You'll also need to set up a Google Sheets or Supabase account for order storage, and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. Additionally, you'll need to have a digital product ready to sell, such as an ebook or plugin.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

The NOWPayments configuration sequence is the same regardless of which stack you are deploying. Create a NOWPayments account — no KYC required, no document upload, no bank account needed. Navigate to the wallet settings and add the wallet addresses for each cryptocurrency you want to accept. USDT on Tron and Bitcoin are the practical starting point for most creators in restricted markets. Generate an API key from the NOWPayments dashboard. Set the webhook endpoint URL in the NOWPayments IPN settings pointing to your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App. Set the webhook secret key — a string you generate that both NOWPayments and your backend know.
You have full ownership and control over your digital store with COREMERCH.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Testing before promotion is not optional — it is the step that determines whether your store functions correctly under real conditions before real buyers encounter it. The test sequence has four steps. First: deploy the backend and confirm the webhook endpoint returns a valid response to a test HTTP POST. Second: configure the storefront and confirm the checkout displays correctly on desktop and mobile. Third: complete a real mainnet transaction with a small amount of actual crypto. Fourth: check your order database and confirm the order was logged correctly, the delivery email arrived, and the download link works.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

To scale your digital store once the infrastructure is running, you can use the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to deploy a more robust infrastructure, complete with Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments. This stack is deployed in 48 hours and includes 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff. This allows you to scale your digital store quickly and easily, without relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
